acip: MIG RAB RIB KYIS BSLAD PA'I MTHU YIS RAB RIB CAN GYIS RANG GI LAG GI BSE RU LA SOGS PA'I BZA' BTUNG GI SNOD KYI NANG DU, SKRA SHAD DANG LA SOGS PAS SBRANG MA LA SOGS PA MTHONG BA NA,
english: Suppose then that—due to the fact that a person's eyes are infected with some cataracts—a person who possesses such optical defects looks into a cup of horn held in their hand (or any similar vessel for eating or drinking), and perceives there a strand of hair “or something of the like” (which words indicate anything similar perceived inside the cup; say, a fly or the like).
